findings.summary: Submitting a product description on Home never produces the promised discovery questions: POST /api/briefs returns HTTP 500 on every attempt (3/3), the UI shows no error (status keeps promising 'Discovery will ask a few questions as a form'), and a page reload silently discards the pending state. The created project ends up with no brief, despite the brief page claiming 'Projects started from the Home composer arrive with one.'

Promote to build never shows the contract: the dialog says 'Building the proposal…' then displays a raw '500 Internal Server Error' (GET/POST /api/projects/proj_odC4Q4kdTHIB/promote/preview failed twice). The user can never read the tasks, acceptance criteria, journeys or spend estimate before agreeing.

Because the proposal compile fails, 'Confirm and compile' remains permanently disabled — there is no way to agree to the contract or land work on the Board. The disable is correct behavior given no proposal, but the end-to-end journey dead-ends here.

Every failed Start attempt silently creates a duplicate project: three identical 'Build a REST API that shortens URLs, with rate limiting' projects now exist, all brief-less, with zero feedback to the user that anything was created or failed.
Dashboard stats go stale: the Home page reported '5 active projects' while seven mission cards were visible on the Projects page after the duplicates were created.
A raw '500 Internal Server Error' string is surfaced verbatim inside the Promote dialog instead of a human-readable failure message with a retry path.

The Governor gauge reads '32/40 · 0 free' sessions throughout; if brief/proposal compilation depends on free agent sessions, exhaustion may be the cause of the 500s, but the UI never connects the two for the user.
